LanguageData.AM_HuntFocus_Bruxa.description:
Our purpose is clear: to seek out the cursed vampiros wherever they may hide.

Bruxa will be the focus of this precept.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - All attacks against a Bruxa will cause extra 10 burn damage.

LanguageData.AM_SanguophageCamps_RaidingDesired.descr:
The lurking dens of vampiros are a blight upon the world, festering with unnatural corruption. We take pride in raiding these camps, striking at their cursed kind.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - If this precept is active in your colony, you will get Campamento de vampiros quests once per quadrum. These are storyteller-independent, they don't take the "slot" of a base game quest.
